title: V-8 ENGINE "454" C.I.D. HI PERF.- RADIATOR HOSES & HEAT SHIELD
summary: LS5 454 big-block upper and lower radiator hoses and a heat shield low on the side of the engine below the exhaust ports. The shield [1] bolts to a bracket on the engine with a production bolt through washer [2]; the inlet hose [5] and outlet hose [3] are held with clamps (clamp [4] plus production clamps), and the inlet hose must clear the generator (alternator) belt by .94 minimum.

parts.name: SHIELD
parts.name_expanded: Shield – heat shield (engine side, below exhaust manifold)

fastening.to: bracket on the side of the engine below the exhaust ports
fastening.note: Production bolt (PROD PARTS, no callout) goes through washer [2] and the shield [1] into the engine-mounted bracket; a second production washer is shown under the bolt head.

fastening.to: radiator inlet and water outlet on engine
fastening.note: View A: inlet hose [5] is held at both ends by production clamps. Keep .94 minimum clearance between the hose and the generator belt.
View A: clamp [4] on one end of outlet hose [3]; the other end uses production clamp [A] (part number & installation same as production).

notes: [A] Part number & installation same as production.
notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch clips the second digit; looks like 9 but not certain, recorded as '?'.
Hoses [3] and [5] carry a half-filled circle symbol with no legend on this sheet.
Which radiator neck each hose meets is inferred from names (inlet = upper, outlet = lower); drawing shows View A only partially.
